newsitem.title: USA: Singer Mel Torme recovering from stomach ailment.
newsitem.headline: Singer Mel Torme recovering from stomach ailment.

text.p: Singer Mel Torme, who suffered a stroke last month, is being treated in a hospital intensive care unit for a gastro-intestinal complaint, his publicist said Friday.
The 71-year-old singer, nicknamed "The Velvet Fog" for his throaty voice, should be out of intensive care early next week to resume his neurological rehabilitation, said Rob Wilcox.
He said the complaint, which forced Torme back into the intensive care unit this week, was now under control.
Torme suffered a minor stroke on Aug. 8 and Wilcox said he expected him to soon resume his singing career.
